purpose: Record organization-wide code-search discovery candidates for the PR #29 status-consumer audit. This is a candidate register, not a complete source-tree scan or VERIFIED claim.

limitations: Search results are discovery signals and may be ranked, truncated, indexed incompletely, or limited to default-branch content.
Search does not prove absence of consumers in unreturned files, private/unindexed repositories, generated code, scripts, or dynamically constructed status mappings.
Each candidate requires direct file inspection at an exact commit and classification by status domain before the audit can be closed.

status_domains.rule: Apply the PR #29 normative contract. No implicit promotion between states.
Finding remediation state is not interchangeable with reconciliation-report status.
Catalog record states must be interpreted under the catalog schema and must not be mapped automatically to reconciliation status.
Discovery or test detection does not prove semantic correctness or reconciled test evidence.
Classify according to the owning repository's contract; do not assume a shared enum solely from matching strings.

required_follow_up: Repository listing and default-branch SHA pinning completed for the 26 non-archived repositories visible to the authenticated account; seven archived repositories were excluded from the active scan but must be considered if they are in scope.

Code-search index is unavailable for 12 active repositories; inspect their pinned Git trees directly or record an explicit access/tooling blocker. Do not infer absence of consumers from no search results.
For each repository, inspect all relevant workflow files, scripts, schemas, report producers, status readers/writers, and generated consumers at the pinned SHA.
Classify each hit as normative specification, producer, consumer, schema, test, documentation, unrelated homonym, or unknown; unknown classifications remain blockers.
Fetch referenced workflow runs, jobs, steps, exit codes, logs, and artifacts and bind each evidence record to the exact source SHA.
Add consumer-specific negative tests proving DETECTED and RECONCILED cannot be promoted to VERIFIED, then run exact-head CI after the complete audit inventory is updated.
